entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Why did I suddenly feel dizzy? Am I[n]just tired?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Why in the world did he give me this?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The Phantom Thief Alibaba? Who is this?

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: I am Alibaba, a member of the[n]Phantom Thieves. I inquire as[n]to your justice, Sae Niijima.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: How do they know I still have this!?

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: Do not speak.

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: Stand still and listen.

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: You will hear the reaper opening a door.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: (What are they talking about?)

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: (The sound of a door opening?)

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: Goro Akechi is evil.

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: He didn't come to interrogate[n]the captured phantom thief...

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: He came to kill him.

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: Stay calm. Don't head back.[n]You'll run into him.

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: Walk to the interrogation room.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: No one's here!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Where's Akechi!? There's only one way[n]out of this room!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: What the hell is going on!?

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: Don't trust the guard, either.[n]He's an accomplice as well.

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: Now then, I'll tell you detailed steps[n]to take.

entries.speaker: Phantom Thief Alibaba
entries.en: You must save [f 4 3].

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Nnh...
